manifest.name: relay
manifest.description: A quiet notebook for project context. Optional nested folders, boards, custom note templates, project logos, and reversible bulk deletion.
manifest.releaseNotes: First Relay build. Start with notes or nested folders; customize templates and board columns; upload project logos; move a whole folder tree to Trash and restore it together. Notes and attachments stay in your Tabs profile. Local development package; marketplace publication pending registry readiness.

listing.externalServices: None. Notes, project logos, attachments, and Trash stay in local extension profile browser storage. No telemetry or cloud sync.
